description: This file defines the Tracking controller class for the account section in an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform. It handles displaying tracking info and product search autocomplete functionality for logged-in users.

classes.name: Tracking
classes.description: Controller class for handling account tracking-related actions, including displaying the tracking page and product autocomplete.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the tracking page, verifying login, affiliate status, loading necessary data, and rendering the view.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests for product search autocomplete, returns JSON with matching product names and links.
